Recorded claim:
Adding encryptionCapabilities made identity change values nested objects. The tracker changed from direct value comparison to JSON.stringify comparison and states its assumption that API objects have stable property order. This avoids reporting every new object as changed and lets onUpdated expose actual capability changes. Current code retains the comparison. If conversion order or object shape changes, inspect this event comparison and its MV2/MV3 tests; the stringify shortcut is local to this ordered API output, not a general deep-equality rule.
